description: This file provides utility functions for managing and selecting test files in a Cypress end-to-end testing setup, including filtering, sorting, and metadata-based selection.

methods.name: grepCommand
methods.description: Constructs a grep command string to search for a word within the TEST_DIR directory.

methods.name: grepFiles
methods.description: Executes a shell command to find files matching a pattern and filters for spec.js or spec.ts files.

methods.name: findFiles
methods.description: Finds files matching a pattern within the TEST_DIR/integration directory, recursively.

methods.name: getBaseTestFiles
methods.description: Retrieves base test files based on command-line arguments for stage, group, and inversion.

methods.name: getWeightedFiles
methods.description: Returns files with associated weights for sorting based on metadata.

methods.name: reorderFiles
methods.description: Reorders files based on a specified order.

methods.name: removeFromFiles
methods.description: Removes specified files from a list.

methods.name: getSortedTestFiles
methods.description: Main function to get a sorted list of test files considering filters, metadata, and environment.

methods.name: getFilesByMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves files matching given metadata tags.

methods.name: printMessage
methods.description: Prints a message with a list of files in cyan color.

methods.name: getSkippedFiles
methods.description: Returns files to skip based on platform, browser, and headless options.
